__doc: L1j-TW-main monster/polymorph gfx -> 3.8c list.spr + raw SPR. Generated by convert_mob_sprites_3_8c.js.
Runtime atlas identity is mob_<sourceGfx>; display-name aliases and substring fallback are forbidden.
npcid 45683 intentionally uses the complete main MyISAM/3.8c old Fafurion presentation gfx 1590.
Old Fafurion fin layer gfx 1592 keeps attr(128) pixels but uses the user-authored additive visibility override.
Flying-dragon polymorph clothes gfx 4220 keeps attr(128) alpha mixing with a custom 96/255 alpha.
Cursed dark-elf clothes gfx 5518/5531/5630 keep attr(128) alpha mixing with a custom 96/255 alpha.
Dragon body-attached client SPRs are resampled onto the body timeline and exported as <action>_effect.
body keeps exact pixels; attr(8) body/layer uses additive alpha=luma; attr(128) body uses custom 96/255 alpha; shadow is black with alpha=255-luma.
A missing action may use raw SPR only from an exact-name folder in the two user-designated supplemental roots.
